description: Inside this window, A0100 or A0200 shows a clear before/after transition in its movement pattern supported by commands and actual motion, or recorded evidence supports a new missile-firing action by that aircraft. Firing can qualify without a movement change.

Neither a movement-pattern transition nor new firing by A0100 or A0200 is supported inside this window. Command switching or larger oscillations with unchanged motion, ongoing behavior, external situation changes alone, pre-window events, or insufficient evidence do not qualify.
